direct_evidence.title: 2026-10-01-rcs-29206-comentario-interno
direct_evidence.body:
**Finding. The 0 for 24 Aug to 27 Sep is the real result of the rule. No partner met all three thresholds in that period.**

| Fiscal period | Trigger search rows, 30 Sep | Partners with controllable discounts on hierarchy 085 | Partners meeting 2 transactions, 2 dates and $30 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 29 Jun to 26 Jul | 4 | 131 | 3 |
| 27 Jul to 23 Aug | 2 | 48 | 2 |
| 24 Aug to 27 Sep | 0 | 103 | 0 |

**How I checked.** I took the discount codes from the transactions behind August work items 156176 and 156175: Partner Discount code 6, controllable codes 3 and 4, ProductHierarchy1 085. I rebuilt the rule on ARDM_PRODUCTION.C166_SBX with those values. P2 matches the live search exactly. P1 is one short because the rebuild leaves out the second product hierarchy list, which I could not read.

**Ruled out so far:** the reference_Employee join, the partner fields on ardm_header, the item and product joins, and a change in discount codes. All complete before and after 27 Aug.

direct_evidence.title: 2026-10-01-rcs-29206-respuesta-manish
direct_evidence.body:
Hello Manish,

Thank you for your patience while I looked into the serve ware work item.

I reviewed the fiscal period from 24 August to 27 September against the criteria this work item uses. Partners did receive controllable discounts on serve ware in that period. From what I can see, none of them reached all three thresholds together: at least two transactions, on at least two different dates, adding up to at least $30 in controllable discounts.

That looks to be why the run came back empty. The same check returns the records you saw for July and August.

I have not found anything wrong with how the work item ran for that period. If it would help, I can walk you through the partners who came closest, or keep this ticket open through the next run so you can compare.

Thanks again for flagging it, and just let me know which you prefer.

Kind regards,
Juan Martinez
Appriss Retail Support
